1	//! K4: combinations (T3 D1 §4.1.1 and §4.1.2, as refined by ROOT's ruling on
     2	//! I12's A1 finding F-1).
     3	//!
     4	//! **A combination is its own solve.** "Its right-hand side is one exact
     5	//! expansion of the combined ledger Σcᵢfᵢ and the combined prescribed coupling,
     6	//! rounded once to p. Its prescribed values are the exact combination, rounded
     7	//! once. It reuses the cached factor of the shared stiffness source, and runs
     8	//! its own schedule and stop rule. The operands' results never change." The
     9	//! combined ledger holds the exact products cᵢ·v of every operand's load terms
    10	//! (`RetainedLedger::combined`); each prescribed value is the exact sum of the
    11	//! products cᵢ·vᵢ, rounded once at p (`CasePrep::combination`). The combination
    12	//! then runs the case schedule (`run_schedule`) over 128, 256 and 512, each
    13	//! verified at 2p, ceiling 1024, with the stop rule and S\* of its own values:
    14	//! "its published outputs go through the stop rule exactly as case outputs do,
    15	//! with S\* taken from the combination's own body scale", and "a combination
    16	//! whose candidates disagree escalates independently of its operand cases. At
    17	//! the ceiling, it is withheld … (reason `combination_unresolved`), and its
    18	//! operand cases keep their standing."
    19	//!
    20	//! The former formation Σcᵢ·uᵢ of the operands' retained states is withdrawn
    21	//! (ROOT, F-1): with one linear K the two agree in exact arithmetic, but Σcᵢuᵢ
    22	//! loses operand loads that cancel below both p's and 2p's resolution, and
    23	//! the stop rule cannot see a loss common to both. No operand state is used,
    24	//! so no operand is solved on demand.
    25	//!
    26	//! Rules: the operands are case solves (not combinations) sharing one
    27	//! stiffness identity (nodes, members, springs, directional springs and the
    28	//! constrained DOF set), one published layout, and the same stations and
    29	//! support groups (ROOT's ruling on RV19-3: a station's fraction and a group's
    30	//! members are not in the layout, which holds only their ids). The combination's shared
    31	//! stages at p come from the operands' caches when any of them built (or
    32	//! failed) them, and are counted in full against the combination's case limit
    33	//! and against the invocation only when built here, as for any case of a
    34	//! group.

    64	/// evidence carries the combination's identity and combined ledger), or the
    65	/// reason it is withheld with its attempts.
    66	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    67	pub enum CombinationOutcome {
    68	    Selected(Box<RetainedSolve>),
    69	    Unresolved {
    70	        reason: CombinationReason,
    71	        attempts: Vec<AttemptRecord>,
    72	    },
    73	}

    75	/// Combinations Σ cᵢ·(case i) of selected cases.
    76	pub struct RetainedCombination;

    78	impl RetainedCombination {
    79	    /// The combination's own solve (module documentation).
    80	    pub fn solve(
    81	        operands: &[(f64, &RetainedSolve)],
    82	        case_limit: CaseLimit,
    83	        meter: &mut InvocationMeter,
    84	    ) -> CombinationOutcome {
    85	        let withheld = |reason| CombinationOutcome::Unresolved {
    86	            reason,
    87	            attempts: Vec::new(),
    88	        };
    89	        if operands.is_empty() || operands.iter().any(|o| !o.0.is_finite()) {
    90	            return withheld(CombinationReason::NoOperands);
    91	        }
    92	        if operands.iter().any(|o| !o.1.prep.factors.is_empty()) {
    93	            return withheld(CombinationReason::NestedCombination);
    94	        }
    95	        let first = operands[0].1;
    96	        let identity = first.prep.source.stiffness_encoding();

   102	                || o.prep.source.supports() != supports
   103	        }) {

   107	            .iter()
   108	            .map(|(c, o)| (*c, o.prep.as_ref()))

   111	            Ok(p) => Arc::new(p),
   112	            Err(e) => return withheld(CombinationReason::LedgerUnavailable(e)),
   113	        };

   115	        match run_schedule(prep, first.group.clone(), &mut cache, case_limit, meter) {

   117	            CaseOutcome::Unresolved {

   120	                ..
   121	            } => CombinationOutcome::Unresolved {
   122	                reason: CombinationReason::CombinationUnresolved,
   123	                attempts,
   124	            },

   126	                reason, attempts, ..
   127	            } => CombinationOutcome::Unresolved {
   128	                reason: CombinationReason::Unresolved(reason),
   129	                attempts,
   130	            },
   131	            CaseOutcome::Refused { refusal, .. } => withheld(CombinationReason::Refused(refusal)),
   132	        }
   133	    }
